Static fixtures for Ethereum transaction recipient dead-drop resolution. loader.js is the deobfuscated article stage; ordinary-chain-query.js retains sender-filtered chain queries without endpoint decoding or payload activation. Never execute these fixtures.

rotated-loader.js changes the sender selector, RPC providers, and stage paths. Both loader fixtures must fire ethereum-offset-recipient-endpoint and ethereum-offset-recipient-eval-stage (hostile); ordinary-chain-query.js must fire neither.
